title: A score functions allographically by defining an equivalence class that prevents identity drift through performance compliance.
source: Goodman, Nelson — Languages of Art: An Approach to a Theory of Symbols — 1968 — Chapter IV: "The Score", pp. 128, 177–179.

4. Semantic finite differentiability (it is always possible to determine compliance).
